name: Voxelizer Forward Pass
definition: A CUDA-based voxelization and rendering pipeline that processes 3D Gaussians into a volume. It computes radii, generates tile/depth keys for sorting, identifies tile ranges, and renders the volume by blending Gaussians per tile.
summary: The Voxelizer Forward Pass rasterizes 3D Gaussians into a volumetric grid using CUDA, distinguished by handling Gaussian duplication across tile boundaries and employing radix sort for efficient aggregation.
